Pairwise spherical Cauchy KL validation
========================================

The identity KL(P_a || P_b) = K_D(delta(a,b)) was checked on
14 noncollinear parameter pairs in dimensions 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 17, and 33.
Each pair was evaluated by an independent two-dimensional spherical quadrature.
Both parameter orders were integrated separately.

Maximum forward quadrature error: 5.050537765783e-11
Maximum reverse quadrature error: 8.316813904230e-11
Maximum forward-reverse discrepancy: 5.669598124314e-11
Maximum PyTorch evaluator error: 1.332267629550e-14

All values are absolute errors in float64.
